description.line1: Fullstack developer specialised in TypeScript / Nuxt.js / Firebase. AI-augmented.
description.line2: {years} years of development in agile teams on high-audience products, backed by 15 years in IT.
description.line3: Software Craftsmanship advocate: TDD, DDD, pair programming.

paragraphs.p1: Passionate developer with over 15 years of experience in IT, I transitioned to development {years} years ago, driven by my passion for digital and discovering code and Software Craftsmanship best practices.
paragraphs.p2: My unique journey, starting as a helpdesk technician and evolving into system and network administration, has given me a holistic view of information systems. This experience enriches my development practice, allowing me to approach projects as a whole, from infrastructure to code.
paragraphs.p3: As a freelancer, I particularly focus on Clean Code principles and craft development practices. I firmly believe that code quality and long-term maintainability are as important as immediate functionality.
paragraphs.p4: My dual technical expertise — infrastructure and development — allows me to bring unique added value to projects, combining technical robustness and code excellence.

mgm.title: MGM — MyGameMobile
mgm.shortDescription: 10K monthly users — performance analysis and decision support
mgm.description: Mobile app for performance analysis and decision support, built for Decathlon teams. I owned the product and held a functional lead role with the business, from design through to run. 10,000 users a month, worldwide.

fcs.title: FCS — Customer Satisfaction Family
fcs.description: Mobile self-assessment app for Decathlon in-store teams, run for the same division as MyGameMobile. 5,000 users a month, worldwide.

stic.title: STIC — Transverse Cycle Identification Solution
stic.shortDescription: 2K daily users — bicycle registration and QR code scanning
stic.description: Mobile app for pairing and registering bicycles, with an embedded QR code scanner for in-store enrolment. 2,000 users a day, in France.

winky.title: Winkyverse
winky.shortDescription: €24.5M raised — the largest French ICO of 2021
winky.description: Sale platform and KYC flow for the Winkyverse ICO, the educational metaverse built by the startup Mainbot. Opening a sale draws thousands of buyers within seconds, on extreme financial flows: the platform has to absorb that spike without losing a transaction or loosening compliance. The ICO raised €24.5M, the largest French raise of 2021. My scope covered the sale and KYC, not the tokenomics.

mechachain.title: Mechachain
mechachain.shortDescription: 10K buyers — sale and KYC for a play-to-earn game
mechachain.description: Sale platform and KYC flow for the Mechachain ICO, the play-to-earn mecha game by EthernalHorizons. The same exercise as the Winkyverse in the same year, under the same constraint: an audience spike lasting seconds at opening, on amounts that leave no room for approximation. 10,000 buyers.

mc.title: Managers Companion
mc.shortDescription: Agentic AI layer — mobile and desktop for in-store teams
mc.description: Mobile and desktop app for Decathlon in-store staff: performance analysis and self-assessment. I integrated an AI layer under an agentic architecture.

highlights: Same client since 2021, across three successive scopes
